verdict.rationale: Interview self-scheduling is a fair axis for an ATS like Greenhouse, but the evidence pack never documents candidate booking links or live team-calendar availability. The only scheduling-related claim is that Voice AI runs an AI voice interview "on the candidate's schedule". That is an adjacent feature, not calendar-based self-scheduling with recruiters or interviewers.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
